import polars as pl
import io

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    'name': ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie'],
    'age': [25, 30, 35],
    'salary': [50000.0, 60000.0, 70000.0]
})

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to read from the beginning
buffer.seek(0)

# Read the Parquet data back into a new DataFrame
df_loaded = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

# Verify the round trip was successful
print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)
print("\nLoaded DataFrame:")
print(df_loaded)
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.frame_equal(df_loaded))

import polars as pl

    'name': ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie'],
    'age': [25, 30, 35],
    'salary': [50000.0, 60000.0, 70000.0]
})

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = io.BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Reset buffer position to read from the beginning
buffer.seek(0)

# Read the Parquet data back into a new DataFrame
df_loaded = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

# Verify the round trip was successful

print("\nLoaded DataFrame:")
